description: Registry of protocol business-fact kinds. A kind is <namespace>/<name>@<major>; the namespace dtp is reserved for kinds registered here by pull request, and every other namespace is a publisher organization id, whose kinds need no registration. Each protocol kind lists the digests of the profile versions admitted for it; a host that supports a kind loads this file as operator configuration and admits those exact profiles. A kind is registered only once it has fixtures and a second, separately coded implementation has passed them (sdk/tests/interop). A host admits a registered contract with profile.admit; the contracts themselves live beside their documents under profiles/<name>/<major>/profile.json.

rules.kind: ^(dtp|<organization id>)/[a-z][a-z0-9._-]{0,79}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$; the major is the first component of the profile version
rules.expansion: a kind selects every admitted, accessible profile whose publisher, name and major match it (private kinds) or every admitted profile whose digest this registry lists for it (protocol kinds); a kind that selects nothing is an explicit unsupported_profile error, never an empty page
